in_urdu.name: سمرا

in_pashto.name: سمرا

The name is derived from the Arabic word "samera" which means abundance or generosity. In Islamic teachings, being generous is one of the keys to earning Allah's pleasure and blessings. The name Samraa is a reminder to live a life of generosity and to use the blessings that have been bestowed upon us to help others and bring about positive change in the world. Additionally, the name Samraa can be seen as a reminder of Allah's infinite generosity and mercy towards His creation.
